svg.title: Is my idea validated? A five point checklist
svg.desc: Five conditions: you have spoken to twenty or more people who have the problem; sixty percent rate its severity eight out of ten or higher; half are already paying for a workaround; five to ten people have committed money; and you can say who the product is not for. The middle three are the numbers measured at the decision gate; the other two are judgement calls. All five must hold, or the idea is still an assumption.

g.text: You have spoken with 20+ people who have the problem
60% of them rate its severity 8/10 or higher
Half are already paying for a workaround
5–10 people have committed money, not praise
You can say plainly who this is not for
THREE NUMBERS, TWO JUDGEMENT CALLS · ALL FIVE OR IT IS STILL AN ASSUMPTION
